BiblicalUsage: A tendril is the young shoot of the vine, and the prophets watch it cut. Before the harvest the LORD cuts off the sprigs with pruning hooks and takes away the branches; the vine of Sibmah sends its plants over the sea, and the spoiler falls on its summer fruits.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the vine belongs to the LORD to prune: the tendrils are His to cut, and the cutting is judgment when the vine bears no fruit for Him. The vine of Sibmah sends its tendrils over the sea, and the spoiler still finds them.
